_notes: Music tracks. Files live in res://assets/audio/music/ as .ogg (set them to loop in the Import tab). A missing file plays nothing.
volume_db: 0 is full volume, -6 is about half as loud.
what: a short brief for the composer (or the music AI).

title_theme.what: Main theme. Sparse and intimate: a lone acoustic guitar or piano, soft strings far behind, snow-quiet. Melancholy but warm, a small-town mystery in winter. Loops.

ch01_intro.what: Opening of Chapter 1: a night train climbing a mountain pass. Starts calm, the theme's melody on one instrument, then tension as the snow comes. About 60 seconds, ends on a held note.
